templates.quicksort:
let rec quicksort xs =
	match xs with
	| [] = []
	| pivot : tail =
		let less = filter (<= pivot) tail in
		let greater = filter (> pivot) tail in
		quicksort less ++ [pivot] ++ quicksort greater
templates.foldl:
let rec foldl f acc xs =
	match xs with
	| [] = acc
	| x:xs = foldl f (f acc x) xs
templates.zip:
let rec zip xs ys =
	match (xs, ys) with
	| ([], _) = []
	| (_, []) = []
	| (x:xs, y:ys) = (x, y) : zip xs ys

examples.Merge Sort:
-- Merge sort implementation
let rec merge xs ys =
	match (xs, ys) with
	| ([], ys) = ys
	| (xs, []) = xs
	| (x:xs, y:ys) =
		if x <= y then x : merge xs (y:ys)
		else y : merge (x:xs) ys

let rec mergesort xs =
	match xs with
	| [] = []
	| [x] = [x]
	| _ =
		let len = length xs in
		let half = len / 2 in
		let left = take half xs in
		let right = drop half xs in
		merge (mergesort left) (mergesort right)

in mergesort [5, 2, 8, 1, 9]
